scripts.start: npx concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.start:all: npx concurrently "npm run start:service --workspaces" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules frontend/dist && rm -f package-lock.json backend/package-lock.json frontend/package-lock.json && echo 'Clean complete!'
scripts.docker:clean: docker-compose down --volumes && docker container prune -f && docker image prune -f && echo 'Docker cleanup complete!'
